title: Ghazi hai bata denge
body:
nau laakh ke lashkar ki hum neend uda denge
ghazi hai bata denge
hum bayyat e faasiq ke khyber ko gira denge
ghazi hai bata denge
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sher e ilaahi hai hum uske dil o jaan hai
hum shaah e shuja’at hai hum sher e nayastan hai
ye ran ki zameen kya hai hum arsh hila denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhein jo khuda ki hai un aankhon ke taare hai
hyder ke dulaare hai do maaon ke pyare hai
takrayega jo humse hum usko mita denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
do gaam bade aage jurrat hai bhala kis mein
dekhe jo suye qaima himmat hai bhala kis mein
khat khaynch ke naize se deewar bana denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaigham ki nazron mein kya fauj hai kya lashkar
ye shaam ke shab zaade mar jayenge ghut ghut kar
jab ghaiz mein hum inko naize ki hawa denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladne ke liye ran mein is sher e dilawar se
niklega koi marhab jab shaam ke lashkar se
hum faatahe khyber ka andaaz dikha denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal subho ko maula ne gar izn e wigha bakhsha
is shaam ke lashkar ka anjaam ajab hoga
haibat se jagaya hai naize se sula denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamsheer ki chadar par padti thi nazar jis dam
takta tha suye gardoon kehta yehi zaigham
parde pe jo aanch aayi suraj ko bujha denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazlooma ne muztar ne bekas ne hazeena ne
is mashk ko parcham mein baandha hai sakina ne
is mashk ki khaatir hum shaano ko kata denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo mera bilal aqaa wo shaah e wafa ghazi
qaime se suye darya ye kehke chala ghazi
hum pyaas mein pani ko chullu se gira denge
ghazi hai bata denge
nau laakh ke lashkar ki...
author: Bilal Kazmi
